extracted.name: Mandarin Orange Gelatin Salad
extracted.description: A friend taught me to make this years ago - without a recipe. It is very quick and easy. The sweet, creamy salad is great as a cool, refreshing side dish or dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (6 ounce) package orange flavored Jell-O® mix
instruction_lines: Mix thawed frozen whipped topping, mandarin oranges, cottage cheese, and orange-flavored gelatin mix in a large bowl. Chill for 2 to 3 hours before serving.
